definitions: A narrow band of fabric worn around the head, especially by women, to hold the hair in place or as a decorative accessory.
A strapless top, often part of a bikini or worn as a standalone garment, covering the breasts.
A narrow strip or band, especially one used in architecture or design.
examples: She secured her hair with a silk bandeau.
The model wore a black bandeau with high-waisted shorts.
The architect incorporated a decorative bandeau above the window.
